name: Oceanside Pets Spaw
address: 12577 Biscayne Blvd, North Miami, FL 33181, United States

reviewSamples.author: Vanessa
reviewSamples.text: The Oceanside team is phenomenal! They always take excellent care of my doggy, especially this summer for her 8th birthday. The facility is clean and they are kind from the front desk and beyond. They make you feel comfortable and safe.

reviewSamples.author: Riley
reviewSamples.text: Called and they got me in ASAP within 30 minutes as well as one of the best pet spas I've ever been to. Had my girl in and out within 45 minutes, dressed her up for Halloween was the sweetest surprise. The best part of all affordable.

reviewSamples.author: Neka Pierre
reviewSamples.text: I've been bringing my fur babies, Bruce and Maddie, to Oceanside Pets Spaw for the past three months, and every single time I pick them up, I leave beyond happy. They always come back looking amazing, and it's obvious they were cared for.

reviewSamples.author: Engels Vitiello
reviewSamples.text: I've been bringing my dog to Oceanside Pets Spaw for a long time, and I wouldn't trust anyone else with my baby. This pet grooming salon in North Miami consistently provides professional, loving, and high-quality dog grooming services.

reviewSamples.author: Yury Tirado
reviewSamples.text: I love Oceanside Pets Spaw! The groomers are professional, kind, and very knowledgeable. My dog always looks great and is treated with care and patience. Clean salon and excellent dog grooming service. Highly recommend!

notas_research: Research previo en este slug (commit 585beeb9) habia generado un content.json con el patron degradado prohibido ('negocio local en North Miami, FL. Informacion, fotos y contacto verificados en Google Maps', copy generico de 'oficio'/handyman). Se redescartó y se rehizo research+build completo: _research_place.js confirmo rating 4.7/241 reseñas, direccion, telefono, horarios y trajo 5 reviews verbatim reales; se verifico que oceansidepetspaw.net (unico candidato de dominio propio encontrado por busqueda web) NO resuelve por DNS, asi que has_own_site se mantiene false. No se encontro Instagram, Facebook ni email publico tras busqueda dedicada.
